proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q hq h x
  have e : ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) ^ 3 + a * ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) ^ 2 + b * ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) + c = ((p ^ 3 - 3 * p * q ^ 2 + a * (p ^ 2 - q ^ 2) + b * p + c : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((q * (3 * p ^ 2 - q ^ 2 + 2 * a * p + b) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    linear_combination (3 * (p : ℂ) * q ^ 2 + (q : ℂ) ^ 3 * Complex.I + (a : ℂ) * q ^ 2) * Complex.I_sq
  rw [e] at h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.zero_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.zero_im] at hre him
  have hb : 3 * p ^ 2 - q ^ 2 + 2 * a * p + b = 0 := by
    have h1 : q * (3 * p ^ 2 - q ^ 2 + 2 * a * p + b) = 0 := by linarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hq
  have hc : p ^ 3 - 3 * p * q ^ 2 + a * (p ^ 2 - q ^ 2) + b * p + c = 0 := by linarith
  linear_combination x * hb + hc - p * hb
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), q ≠ 0 → ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) ^ 3 + a * ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) ^ 2 + b * ((p : ℂ) + q * Complex.I) + c = 0 → ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ 3 + a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = (x - (-a - 2 * p)) * (x ^ 2 - 2 * p * x + p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)
